title: Maasai beadwork
summary: Stitch four strands on a round leather collar, then thread every bead in the colours of its strand: white, red and white, blue, and orange with yellow.
howToPlay: The framed picture shows the finished collar.
Press and drag with the thread to stitch each ring.
Tap a colour, then tap a bead hole to thread it.
Press Next or Check when a strand is done.
rules: Score: how closely your thread follows the guide, and how many beads hold the right colour.
A bead of the wrong colour counts against you; undo takes back the last bead.
Three stars for 88 or more, two stars for 65 and one star for 40. Watch and learn threads a whole collar for you.
Every strand has its own colours; a bead left empty or in the wrong colour costs points.
heritageNote: Maasai women make wide collars, necklaces and bracelets from small glass beads. Colour and pattern are chosen with care, and the beads are strung in rings on thread and leather.
